questions.q: State what is meant by abstraction.

markPoints.concept: removing unnecessary detail to leave only what matters
accept: remove|removing|ignore|ignoring|leave out|leaving out|hide|hiding|strip|get rid of|take away|filter out
markPoints.exemplar: Removing unnecessary detail from a problem.

questions.example: Removing the details that do not matter, so that only the important features of the problem are left.
questions.paraphrase: Stripping out information that is not relevant and keeping only what is needed.
questions.feedback: Removing detail. Saying only 'making something simpler' does not say how.
questions.revisitLabel: 2.1 Lesson 1 — Abstraction studio, station 2: What abstraction is

questions.q: A London Underground map shows the order of the stations but not the real distances between them. Which idea does this illustrate?
questions.feedback: The real distances are detail a traveller does not need, so they are left out.
questions.revisitLabel: 2.1 Lesson 1 — Abstraction studio, station 2: What abstraction is

questions.q: A programmer is writing a game where a car drives round a track. Explain how abstraction helps them.

markPoints.concept: they leave out detail the game does not need
accept: leave out|ignore|ignoring|remove|not include|do not need|does not need|unnecessary|irrelevant|not model|does not model|not affect
markPoints.exemplar: They leave out detail the game does not need, such as how the engine works internally.

markPoints.concept: so the program is simpler, quicker to write and faster to run
accept: simpler|easier|quicker|faster|less code|less work|less to program|smaller|less memory|less processing
markPoints.exemplar: This means the program is simpler and quicker to write.

questions.example: They only model the things that affect the game, such as speed and steering, and leave out detail like how the engine works or what the paint is made of, which makes the program much simpler to write and faster to run.
questions.paraphrase: They ignore anything that does not affect play, such as the internal workings of the engine, so there is far less to program and the game runs more quickly.
questions.feedback: What is left out, then what leaving it out buys.
